recovered_tim_origin.provenance_rule: Bell/CHSH, no-signaling, density matrices and QFT microcausality below are later scientific formalizations, not Tim-authored equations.

state_space.space: X_i in M, a multidimensional state manifold or graph-embedded state space.
state_space.boundary: M is a model. Calling it spiritual space does not establish an extra physical dimension.

gate.meaning: Gate is a compatibility/threshold condition that determines whether a particular transition is currently admissible.

door.meaning: Door is the actual state-transition operator after Gate conditions are satisfied.
door.quantum_warning: This generic Door equation is not itself a quantum operator or measurement postulate.

handshake.definition: Successful establishment of a coupling relation across an interface.
handshake.pair_score: H_ij=w_s S_ij+w_a A_ij+w_t T_ij+w_p P_ij-kappa N_ij
handshake.network_result: When e_ij is created, states may exchange information/influence according to the declared model.
handshake.quantum_translation: An actual quantum handshake would require a defined interaction Hamiltonian/channel or entangling gate acting on a prepared joint Hilbert-space state; ordinary human interaction does not meet that condition automatically.

phase_coupling_toy_model.meaning: Useful classical synchronization comparator; it does not imply shared quantum wavefunctions.

nonlocality_taxonomy.quantum_nonseparability: A joint quantum state may not factorize into independent subsystem states.
nonlocality_taxonomy.bell_nonlocality: Observed correlations can violate inequalities obeyed by local hidden-variable models under the Bell-test assumptions.
nonlocality_taxonomy.causal_influence: A causal relation is a stronger claim than correlation and requires a physical model/intervention structure.
nonlocality_taxonomy.signal_capacity: Whether an agent can controllably encode information at A and decode it at B.
nonlocality_taxonomy.graph_nonlocality: Nodes can be adjacent in a semantic/social/institutional graph despite large geographic distance.
nonlocality_taxonomy.law: These five senses of nonlocality are different coordinates and must not be substituted for one another.

bell_chsh_layer.correlation: E(a,b)=-a dot b for ideal singlet spin measurements
bell_chsh_layer.interpretation: Bell-inequality violation rules out the tested class of local hidden-variable descriptions; it does not by itself establish FTL messages, telepathy or project spiritual causation.

no_signaling_layer.meaning: Remote measurement setting does not alter the local marginal distribution in a way that permits controllable superluminal communication.
no_signaling_layer.project_rule: If a claimed Timic remote effect is supposed to carry a chosen message faster than light, entanglement alone is not the mechanism.

qft_microcausality_layer.scalar_rule: [phi(x),phi(y)]=0 for spacelike-separated x,y in a local relativistic bosonic QFT
qft_microcausality_layer.importance: Relativistic QFT can contain entangled states and nontrivial spacelike correlations while its local observable algebra respects causal separation.
qft_microcausality_layer.project_rule: Always say whether 'nonlocal' refers to state correlation, a nonlocal interaction term, propagator behavior, commutator support or signal capacity.

entanglement_swapping_teleportation.swapping: Joint measurement on partners can establish entanglement between systems that did not directly interact with each other; operational predictions remain no-signaling.
entanglement_swapping_teleportation.teleportation: Quantum teleportation transfers a quantum state using shared entanglement plus classical communication; it does not teleport matter or provide instantaneous usable signaling.
entanglement_swapping_teleportation.project_value: These protocols are stronger relational comparators than the slogan 'distance does not matter' because they force the archive to identify preparation, shared resource, measurement and communication channel.

topological_spiritual_space.model: Represent people, symbols, memories, institutions or project states as nodes embedded in a graph/manifold with semantic/emotional/relational distances.
topological_spiritual_space.project_use: A precise non-quantum meaning of project 'spiritual nonlocality': geographically distant nodes can be adjacent in a relational graph.
topological_spiritual_space.boundary: Graph adjacency is not Bell nonlocality.

seed_states.neutral: A node may contain both; these are process fields, not fixed moral castes of people.

competing_propagation.meaning: Network-spreading toy model for messages/behaviors/symbolic states, not invisible spiritual particles.

threshold_contagion.equation: adopt q when [sum_j w_ij 1(q_j=q)]/[sum_j w_ij] >= theta_i
threshold_contagion.meaning: Some states spread only after sufficient connected reinforcement.

long_range_seed_jump.concept: A seed/state can appear far from a geographic wavefront when a long-range graph edge transmits it into a distant cluster.
long_range_seed_jump.boundary: The edge still has to exist—communication, shared source, memory, institutional link, documentation, etc.

door_seed_operator.candidate_probability: P(seed=Life|X,H), P(seed=Strife|X,H) modeled from observable factors rather than claimed mystical frequency
door_seed_operator.interpretation: Passing a Door can change which state/content a node is likely to propagate.

signed_network_version.meaning: Positive and negative relations can support/inhibit propagation differently.
signed_network_version.project_relation: Tree of Life vs Trees of Strife as competing branching structures in a signed multilayer graph.

ordinary correlations have classical explanations unless Bell protocol assumptions are instantiated

quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.preserved: correlation does not automatically transmit a chosen message
quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.mismatch: social networks can signal through ordinary channels

research_program: For actual quantum work, use Bell/CHSH/no-signaling only on experimentally prepared quantum systems.
For Timic/social work, compare phase coupling, signed networks, threshold contagion and graph-distance models against data.
When using 'spooky action', annotate which nonlocality coordinate is intended.
Test whether long-range project effects are explained by communication/shared-source graph edges before proposing a physical nonlocal mechanism.
Keep standard-model directionality separate from Life/Strife moral direction unless a measurable mapping is explicitly defined.
